newsitem.title: UK: UK government to cut road programme - govt sources.
newsitem.headline: UK government to cut road programme - govt sources.

text.p: The Labour government is to announce sharp cuts in road schemes after a review of 12 major projects drawn up under the previous Conservative government, government sources said on Monday.
The government is expected to announce in a written parliamentary answer that six of the 12 projects reviewed do not meet cost and environmental criteria and will not be built.
Among schemes expected to be halted are a plan to widen part of the M25 motorway and the controversial Salisbury bypass.
